summary: Sh. Ali Mashhour delivers a sermon centered on the story of Maryam (Mary), mother of Jesus, and lessons about divine will and preparation. He discusses how Maryam's mother vowed to dedicate her unborn child to Allah's service, expecting a boy, but received a daughter instead. Despite this unexpected outcome, Maryam became one of the most righteous women in history. Sh. Ali Mashhour emphasizes that believers should prepare themselves to be instruments of Allah's will without dictating how, when, or where they will be used. He illustrates this with the inspiring account of Khubayb ibn Adi and Zayd ibn Dathina, companions of Prophet Muhammad who were captured and martyred, yet their sacrifice led to the conversion of their captors and many in the surrounding tribes to Islam.
suggested_title: Divine Will and Unexpected Outcomes: The Stories of Maryam, Khubayb, and Zayd
catchy_title: When Allah's Plan Surpasses Your Expectations
